messages.message: Enter the controlled code edition and verify the enabled formula set before calculation.
An allowable-stress value without a controlled source reference cannot be used.
No approved allowable-stress interpolation policy is configured.
The selected formula is outside its configured range of applicability.
A formula denominator is zero or negative. Do not calculate a result.
The displayed joint-efficiency value is from a historical reference and requires controlled-code verification.
The displayed test-pressure formula is from a historical reference and requires controlled-code and project verification.
A special historical rule is indicated for certain high-tensile-strength formed heads. Verify the current code requirement.
Required thickness is calculated, but no controlled nominal plate thickness library is available for selection.
External pressure and vacuum stability are outside this module.
Nozzle loads, weight, wind, seismic, thermal, support and local loads are not included.
An agitator or mixer is selected. Confirm top-head or shell loading, nozzle reinforcement, shaft clearance, baffles, support arrangement, vibration and vendor data before final mechanical design.
